doc.description: Fixed-Wing Autonomous Precision Landing System. Predicts touchdown point using 2D GNSS position/velocity and rangefinder AGL height. Commands bounded crow braking and rejects unsuitable approaches above commit height. Experimental: prediction is not an accuracy or flight-safety guarantee. Explicit start in AUTO2 is required after pilot takeover. Flare does not change the global throttle-kill flag. Real sensor and aerodynamic validation is required. RC and GCS mode changes must use the autopilot mode setter, never direct assignments. The example validates live parameters and geometry before navigation. Its crow bench test requires fresh near-ground range, near-zero motion, no launch and killed throttle.

define.name: MIN_AIRSPEED
define.description: Minimum safe approach airspeed. Braking is disengaged if airspeed falls below this margin to prevent stall.

define.name: AIRSPEED_TIMEOUT
define.description: Maximum air-data sample age authorizing braking in final or flare.

define.name: APPROACH_CORRIDOR_SLOPE
define.description: Extra lateral corridor width per meter above brake_agl; converges to MAX_CROSS_TRACK.

define.name: MAX_CROSS_TRACK
define.description: Maximum allowable lateral drift from runway centerline (leaves 0.3m safety margin inside official 1.5m half-box).

define.name: MAX_LONG_ERROR
define.description: Maximum allowable longitudinal prediction error before confirming an abort.

define.name: MAX_AIM_DISTANCE
define.description: Maximum upstream glide aim, independent of the unchanged touchdown rejection limits. This geometric intercept is not a predicted stopping distance.

define.name: REJECT_DELAY
define.description: Persistence time requirement for boundary violation before triggering go-around (filters sensor noise).

define.name: BRAKE_ENABLE_AGL
define.description: Highest rangefinder AGL height (m) where close-range predictive crow braking engages.

define.name: ABORT_AGL
define.description: No-powered-abort latch height. Fresh AGL takes precedence; unknown height is conservative. Normal flare height is separate.

define.name: AGL_TIMEOUT
define.description: Maximum age of rangefinder measurement before falling back to barometric altitude.

define.name: MIN_SINK_RATE
define.description: Minimum sink rate floor to prevent numerical division-by-zero during time-to-ground projection.

define.name: AGL_RATE_TAU
define.description: Time constant for rangefinder sink rate low-pass filter (balances noise filtering with flare response).

define.name: BRAKE_GAIN
define.description: Proportional gain converting predicted overshoot meters to crow brake demand.

define.name: MAX_BRAKE
define.description: Maximum allowed total crow brake command (1.0 = 100% full spoileron deflection).

define.name: UPPER_MAX_BRAKE
define.description: Maximum allowed crow brake command in upper barometric altitude band (50% preserves pitch control).

define.name: FLARE_MAX_ROLL
define.description: Maximum roll setpoint allowed during flare to prevent wingtip strikes on belly-landing foam planes.
